ja283:1.1: seyyaṁsajātakaṁ → seyya jātakaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, syā) | cari → caraṁ (bj: sī)
ja283:1.3: byapagamma → byaggha pagamma (sya-all) | vyapagamma → byagghāpagamma (bj: machasaṁ); byagghapagamma (bj: syā)
ja283:2.1: ime sudaṁ → imassutā (sya-all) | ime → imassutāyanti (bj: machasaṁ, syā) | sudaṁ → imassu tā (cck: syā. ka.) | imassutā → ime sudaṁ (sya-all: sī.)
ja283:2.2: puthū → puthu (bj, cck) | bhayaṭṭitā → bhayaddhitā (sya-all) | bhayaṭṭitā leṇagavesino puthū → bhayadditā lenagavesino puthu (pts)
ja283:2.4: yatthaṭṭhitā duppasahajjame → yattha ṭhitā duppasabhajja me (bj) | duppasahajjame → duppasahajjime (sya-all) | duppasahajjame → duppasahajjime (cck: syā.)
